name: SEKA Spear (standard frame) 105 Di2 dealer build
why_interesting: A fully itemised dealer build on the standard Spear frame with 105 Di2 and Magene carbon wheels.

facts.wheels: Magene Ultra Dark 508 carbon-spoke, 50 mm front / 58 mm rear
facts.tires: Michelin Power Cup clincher with Magene TPU tubes
facts.complete_weight_basis: Dealer-stated build weight; size not stated
facts.frame: Spear Standard carbon frame with the Wind Eye seat cluster. SEKA lists 780 g for a size-M bare frame without paint or metal parts (775 g unpainted in the 2024–25 catalog, 860 g painted Twilight Blue).
facts.frame_material: Carbon. SEKA publishes fibre grades only for the RDC frame (TeXtreme and pitch-based fibre).
facts.frame_construction: SEKA's Spear pages and the Standard store listing describe one-mould True-One-Piece construction; the frame routes cables internally through SEKA's Rapier bar system
facts.stiffness_evidence: No stiffness figure is published for the Standard frame; SEKA's 5% stiffness and 14.5% stiffness-to-weight gains compare the RDC with Exceed RDC.
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Official Spear maximum actual tyre width, front and rear, for both RDC and Standard frames (current global and China pages; 2024–25 catalog). The dealer does not state its tyre width.
facts.sizes: XS, S, M, L and XL, plus racing MR and LR
